Company Description MindLytics is a next-generation data and analytics company that helps organizations turn raw data into actionable intelligence. The team specializes in building scalable data infrastructure, advanced analytics solutions, and modern visualization platforms to support faster, smarter decision-making. MindLytics partners with both startups and growing enterprises to enable data-driven cultures through reliable data pipelines, cloud-based architectures, and business intelligence solutions. The company’s mission is to convert raw data into real business value by delivering practical, impact-focused data solutions to its clients.
Role Description This full-time remote Data Scientist role focuses on designing and implementing data-driven solutions that address complex business problems. The Data Scientist will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to collect, analyze, and model data, and to translate findings into clear, actionable insights. Daily responsibilities include building and validating statistical and machine learning models, performing exploratory data analysis, and developing dashboards or visualizations that communicate key metrics and trends. The role also involves maintaining clean, reliable datasets, contributing to scalable data pipelines, and documenting methodologies to support reproducibility and ongoing improvement.
Qualifications

• Candidates should possess strong skills in Data Science and Statistics for modeling, experimentation, and inference.
• Candidates should possess skills in Data Analytics and Data Analysis for interpreting complex datasets and generating insights.
• Candidates should possess skills in Data Visualization for building clear dashboards and visual reports.
• Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in data science (such as Python or R) and experience with SQL or other query languages.
• Familiarity with machine learning libraries, cloud-based data platforms, and version control tools.
• Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences and collaborate effectively in a remote environment.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering) or equivalent practical experience.
• Experience working with business intelligence tools and building end-to-end analytics solutions is beneficial.
